task_name: Place and Construct Second Residential Zone Using Nails

steps.who: Residential Buildings icon with '1' badge (bottom-right menu)

steps.briefing: Drag the Residential Zone onto an empty lot adjacent to the road next to the first residential house or Building Supplies Store.
Confirm placement of the second Residential Zone.

steps.who: yellow hard hat bubble above the new Residential Zone
steps.briefing: Open the material requirements popup for the newly placed zone.
Drag the Nails onto the Residential Zone to complete construction of the second house.

when_to_do_it.trigger_condition: After collecting Nails when the Residential Buildings icon displays a '1' badge.
when_to_do_it.strategic_reasoning: Constructing a second Residential Zone doubles city population to 104, earns Simoleons (+882) and XP, and triggers utility service tutorials.
preconditions: At least 1 Nail in City Storage
Available road space next to existing buildings
when_to_do_it.placement_rule: Place the zone next to the first residential home along the road so future services and parks can cover both homes simultaneously.
